_scope: Film 6 facts list. No value is typed: each fact names the witness, the command that produces the log, the log file and the regex that extracts it. facts6_resolve.js resolves them. status: now = resolved from a final log (lead/final, lead/lane); cut = unresolved from the final logs, not used by the film and named on the limits card.
logdir_default: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-red1-bim-compiler/ef8ba76c-3b22-4dae-94ac-babe90436a0e/scratchpad/lead (the lead's FINAL suite: final/*.log, lane/*.log; copied under film6/logs/evidence/final and lane at recording)
regex_flags: m (multiline); group = capture group number; every regex searches the whole log, first match
